messages.subject: Dealing with missing data properly
parts:
Hi all,

I have another question here. I was trying to repeat the analysis protocol from a paper published on Nature (they used INLA). I found that their dataset contain many missing values, presented in "NA". And I read their Rscript and find not proper management on these missing value. The data was directly input to INLA. I am not sure whether this is a proper way. And what's the inner logic for this? Any comments?

Part of the data goes like this:


Thanks!

Regards,
Chen Yangkang
